observations.message: The unchanged reading in C0000 is incomplete because its summary states that the head of an executive, judicial, or legislative agency may collect the claim by administrative offset after trying under section 3711(a), omitting the mandatory governing conditions set forth immediately thereafter that administrative offset may be collected only after giving the debtor written notice and the specified opportunities under paragraphs (1) through (4).
observations.reviewed_statement: After trying to collect a claim from a person under section 3711(a) of this title, the head of an executive, judicial, or legislative agency may collect the claim by administrative offset.
